The '''Ductavis Holocron''' was a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] that was constructed by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Biel Ductavis]], a leader of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who served as the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="FoD Core Rulebook" /> in the aftermath of the [[Pius Dea Crusades]].<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Following Ductavis' [[Death/Legends|death]], the holocron was stored on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], where it was lost following the evacuation of Ossus as a result of the [[Cron Supernova/Legends|Cron Supernova]].<ref name="FoD Core Rulebook" />

The holocron contained accounts of the ancient history of the Galactic Republic. Later researchers believed that the contents of the holocron could re-write [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history and lead to the rediscovery of the lost worlds of [[Had Abbadon]], [[Lettow]] and [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="FoD Core Rulebook" />
